description: Answers 'which of my backtests performed best?' Give run_ids from earlier run_backtest calls in this session. Returns a table (run_id, CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown, turnover, final equity) for each run. If a run_id is unknown, the error names it - call run_backtest again to get a fresh run_id, or list_strategies to compare published strategies instead.
name: compare_runs
title: Compare runs
